audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's headline was "E his E-Q burst", i.e. use Counter Strike to eat his damage — while the content layer already says the opposite.
audit.why: Counter Strike dodges incoming ATTACKS. Gragas's damage is Barrel Roll, Body Slam and the Drunken Rage-empowered hit; the dodge half of E does nothing about the first two, so the ability is a stun tool here, not a defensive one. The two layers were giving opposite advice on the same screen.
audit.corrected: Full-layer headline, win condition, do's and Key Ability Interactions re-keyed to landing the recast stun after Body Slam (14s at rank 1) instead of dodging his burst.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as your Grandmaster spike and first item as your Trinity Force spike; no cooldowns anywhere.
audit.why: Explosive Cask (100/85/70s) is the bigger level-6 spike — it knocks you out of Counter Strike's recast range so the stun whiffs — and his AP first item bursts before Trinity Force answers. Body Slam is 14s at rank 1 and only falls to 12s at rank 5, so it is the timer the whole lane runs on; Barrel Roll shrinks 10s to 6s.
audit.corrected: Level 6 and first item rewritten as his stages, with Body Slam's 14s, Barrel Roll's 6s floor and Explosive Cask's 100s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gave Jax Levels 2, 3, first item and called 4-5 and 6 Skill, on a 49.25% lane whose own why-strings say "He hits his level-2 trade first", "his strongest window in the lane" and "This is his lane, not yours".
audit.why: The packet chart is Skill/Gragas/Skill/Gragas/Gragas/Gragas/Jax and the mirror flipped to exactly that. Only the side tokens and the generic full-layer whys were wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 2 through first item flipped in both layers as one atomic group with ratings moved, and the full-layer whys rewritten to match what the content layer already said.
